data.name: qms_quejas
data.definition:
SELECT q.id,
    q.folio,
    q.cliente_nombre,
    q.email_cliente,
    q.telefono,
    q.categoria,
    q.descripcion,
    q.prioridad,
    q.estado,
    q.fecha_sla,
    q.fecha,
    q.notas,
    q.resolucion,
    q.responsable_id,
    q.derivado_sacp_id,
    q.fecha_cierre,
    q.fecha_limite_investigacion,
    q.reabierta,
    q.motivo_reapertura,
    q.revision,
    c.codigo AS estado_codigo,
    COALESCE(c.valor, q.estado) AS estado_nombre,
    COALESCE(c.color, 'secondary'::text) AS estado_color,
    r.expires_at AS plazo_vence,
    r.stage_id AS plazo_etapa,
        CASE
            WHEN r.id IS NULL THEN 'completed'::text
            ELSE qms_classify(r.expires_at, r.attention_at)
        END AS plazo_situacion,
        CASE
            WHEN r.expires_at IS NULL THEN NULL::integer
            ELSE (r.expires_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Costa_Rica'::text)::date - (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Costa_Rica'::text)::date
        END AS plazo_dias
   FROM quejas q
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT catalogos.codigo,
            catalogos.valor,
            catalogos.color
           FROM catalogos
          WHERE catalogos.modulo = 'quejas'::text AND catalogos.tipo = 'estado_queja'::text AND catalogos.valor_interno = q.estado
          ORDER BY catalogos.orden, catalogos.id
         LIMIT 1) c ON true
     LEFT JOIN qms_stage_runs r ON r.case_id = q.id AND r.ended_at IS NULL;

data.name: qms_work_items
data.definition:
SELECT qms_quejas.id,
    'quejas'::text AS module,
    qms_quejas.folio,
    qms_quejas.cliente_nombre AS title,
    qms_quejas.categoria,
    qms_quejas.estado_nombre AS state,
    qms_quejas.estado_color AS color,
    qms_quejas.prioridad,
    qms_quejas.plazo_vence AS due,
    qms_quejas.plazo_situacion AS situation,
    qms_quejas.plazo_dias AS days,
    qms_quejas.plazo_etapa AS stage
   FROM qms_quejas
  WHERE qms_quejas.estado <> ALL (ARRAY['Finalizado'::text, 'No Procede'::text, 'Cerrada'::text])
UNION ALL
 SELECT acciones.id,
    'sacp'::text AS module,
    acciones.folio,
    acciones.descripcion AS title,
    acciones.tipo AS categoria,
    acciones.estado AS state,
    'primary'::text AS color,
    acciones.prioridad,
    acciones.fecha_limite AS due,
    qms_classify(acciones.fecha_limite::date + ('23:59:59.999999'::time without time zone AT TIME ZONE 'America/Costa_Rica'::text), NULL::timestamp with time zone) AS situation,
    acciones.fecha_limite::date - (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Costa_Rica'::text)::date AS days,
    NULL::text AS stage
   FROM acciones
  WHERE acciones.estado <> 'Cerrada'::text
UNION ALL
 SELECT documentos.id,
    'documentos'::text AS module,
    NULL::text AS folio,
    documentos.titulo AS title,
    NULL::text AS categoria,
    documentos.estado AS state,
    'secondary'::text AS color,
    NULL::text AS prioridad,
    NULL::timestamp with time zone AS due,
    'unconfigured'::text AS situation,
    NULL::integer AS days,
    NULL::text AS stage
   FROM documentos
  WHERE documentos.estado = ANY (ARRAY['Borrador'::text, 'En Revisión'::text])
UNION ALL
 SELECT riesgos.id,
    'riesgos'::text AS module,
    riesgos.folio,
    riesgos.descripcion AS title,
    NULL::text AS categoria,
    riesgos.estado AS state,
    'warning'::text AS color,
    NULL::text AS prioridad,
    NULL::timestamp with time zone AS due,
    'unconfigured'::text AS situation,
    NULL::integer AS days,
    NULL::text AS stage
   FROM riesgos
  WHERE riesgos.estado = 'Activo'::text;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.generar_folio_queja()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_anio integer := extract(year FROM timezone('America/Costa_Rica', now()))::integer;
  v_ultimo integer;
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO public.folios_quejas_anuales (anio, ultimo)
  VALUES (v_anio, 1)
  ON CONFLICT (anio) DO UPDATE
  SET ultimo = public.folios_quejas_anuales.ultimo + 1
  RETURNING ultimo INTO v_ultimo;

  -- A partir de 1000 no truncar el número a tres caracteres.
  RETURN v_anio::text || '-' || CASE
    WHEN length(v_ultimo::text) >= 3 THEN v_ultimo::text
    ELSE lpad(v_ultimo::text, 3, '0')
  END;
END;
$function$
data.name: generar_folio_queja

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.app_tiene_permiso(p_modulo text, p_requiere_escribir boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.permisos p
    JOIN public.usuarios u ON u.rol = p.rol
    WHERE u.auth_id = auth.uid()
      AND u.estado = 'activo'
      AND p.modulo = p_modulo
      AND p.leer = true
      AND (NOT p_requiere_escribir OR p.escribir = true)
  );
$function$
data.name: app_tiene_permiso

 RETURNS boolean

 FROM qms_calendars WHERE id=p_calendar;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.qms_classify(p_due timestamp with time zone, p_attention timestamp with time zone, p_now timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now())
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT CASE WHEN p_due IS NULL THEN 'unconfigured' WHEN p_due<p_now THEN 'overdue'
 WHEN (p_due AT TIME ZONE 'America/Costa_Rica')::date=(p_now AT TIME ZONE 'America/Costa_Rica')::date THEN 'today'
 WHEN p_attention IS NOT NULL AND p_now>=p_attention THEN 'soon' ELSE 'within' END;
$function$
data.name: qms_classify
